content.text: Our Mission: Inspire the Next Generation Looking to the Future While Honoring Our Legacy The Space Shuttle Challenger crew was dedicated to a mission inspired by education. In 1986, the families of the crew established Challenger Center as a way to honor their loved ones while keeping their educational mission alive. Since then, our STEM programs have inspired and engaged 6.5+ million students through experiential hands-on learning opportunities. 80 Years Championing STEM Education 80 Million+ Students Inspired 80 Challenger Learning Centers Celebrating Our 40th Anniversary 2026 marks 40 years since our founding. Throughout the year, Challenger Center and our network of Challenger Learning Centers will honor the legacy of the Challenger Seven while celebrating four decades of inspiring millions of students through immersive, hands-on STEM learning experiences. Stay tuned for national events, new educational resources, and national recognitions. Together, we can awaken a passion for STEM in the next generation of pioneers and innovators. Empower Every Student Help us continue the educational mission of the Challenger STS-51L crew and ignite students’ potential in STEM. Make a difference in style! Our Challenger Center merchandise is available now, and every purchase supports our mission to inspire students to reach for the stars. Meet Nina Caroline Combemale Middle School Robotics Teacher If a student says, ‘I don’t know what to do,’ I ask them, ‘What do you like to do?’ If they like to read, I might recommend they focus on research. If you like LEGOs, try engineering. It’s a lesson I first learned during my Mission with Challenger Center. Everyone had their own roles, with completely different skill sets, and we all had to work together to succeed.
